name: Tics de langage
description: Cuts the hesitations (euh, heu, hum, um, uh…) and the silences of talking footage. Transcribes with Whisper large-v3-turbo (or base) in 'keep the hesitations' mode: an initial prompt that contains hesitations makes Whisper write them down instead of cleaning them up, so they can be cut by word. Needs the speech model installed (Edit > Preferences > Media Analysis & Transcription, or transcript.downloadModel); large-v3-turbo is 1.6 GB and several times slower than base on the CPU.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Retirer les euh (turbo, français)
entries.description: Transcribe in French with large-v3-turbo keeping hesitations, remove them, then the silences of 0.4 s or more.

entries.label: Retirer les uh/um (turbo, anglais)
entries.description: Same in English: um, uh, erm, hmm.

entries.label: Retirer les euh (base, français)
entries.description: Faster: whisper-base (the model that is installed by default), hesitations kept.

entries.label: Retirer les euh (transcription existante)
entries.description: Only removes the hesitations from the transcript the sequence already has.
